history.intro: Every entry below is tied to the Wikipedia article on Tandag and the works it cites.
history.nameOriginIntro: Three stories survive. None of them is settled — and all three are about not understanding each other.

gettingHere.heading: Getting to Tandag
gettingHere.summary: 448 nautical miles from Manila, 150 from Cebu, 331 km up the road from Davao.

emergency.heading: When the river rises
emergency.intro: Tandag takes weather directly off the Pacific — about {rainfall} mm of rain a year, most of it between November and February, with no real dry season to plan around.
emergency.pendingBody: We are still sourcing verified numbers for {offices}. Publishing a number we cannot check is how someone ends up calling a dead line in a storm. The city's disaster office posts current numbers on its page.
